messages.text: Hi, saw your pouch filling machine on IndiaMART. We pack namkeen in 200g and 500g pouches. Which model suits?
Hello Rajesh ji! For 200-500g namkeen our PR-450 collar-type FFS is best. 35-40 pouches/min. Sharing brochure now.
Brochure dekha. Nitrogen flushing option hai?
Yes ji, N2 flushing is an add-on. PR-450 with N2 comes to ₹6.8 lakh + GST.
Theek hai. We need 2 units. Final price batao for 2, and can you deliver before Diwali? Season rush hai.
Hi, we need a band sealer for spice pouches, 100g to 1kg. What is the price?
Hello Meena ma'am, our PR-CBS770 continuous band sealer with batch coding is ₹68,000 + GST. Brochure attached.
Can it seal 1kg pouches standing? Ours are gusseted.
Yes, with the vertical conveyor option. That is +₹9,500.
Okay. Let me discuss with my partner and get back to you.
Hi Arjun, we met at PackEx. Need a carton sealer + strapping machine for export cartons, around 800 cartons a day.
Hi Imran bhai! PR-CS50 side-belt carton sealer ₹1,15,000 and PR-ST30 semi-auto strapping ₹58,000, both + GST. As a combo I can do ₹1,65,000 + GST.
Combo price is ok. Will you do installation at Tiruppur and train 2 operators?
Yes, free installation and operator training are included.
Good. Please send the proforma invoice, we will release the PO next week.
Need a vacuum packing machine for paneer, 200g and 1kg blocks.
Namaste Deepak ji, our DZ-400 double chamber is ideal for paneer. ₹2,40,000 + GST.
Bit high. Will check.
Hi Deepak ji, any update? We can include a free first-year AMC.
Hi Deepak ji, following up on the vacuum machine. Happy to arrange a demo if useful.
We need an L-sealer with shrink tunnel for medicine cartons. Speed 15-20 per minute.
Hello Anita ma'am, PR-LS45 L-sealer with ST-450 tunnel fits well. Combo ₹2,85,000 + GST. Here is a running video: packright.in/v/ls45
Video looks good. We will discuss it in our Monday meeting and confirm.
Hello Suresh ji, Rahul from PackRight Machines. We make pallet stretch wrappers for agro exporters. Would you like details?
Send details.
Sure ji. PR-SW2000 semi-auto stretch wrapper, ₹3,10,000 + GST. Brochure attached.
Thanks. Budget approval only next quarter, January. Contact then.
Hi, need a vacuum machine with nitrogen flushing for cashew tins and pouches.
Hello Kavita ma'am, DZ-500 with N2 flushing is ₹3,45,000 + GST.
Another supplier quoted ₹3,10,000 for a similar machine. Can you match?
Let me check the best price with my manager and revert.
Priya, any update? We need to finalise this week.
Strapping machine price?
Sat Sri Akal Harpreet ji, PR-ST30 semi-auto is ₹58,000 + GST.
We have finalised with another vendor. Thanks.
Hi, we are opening a new outlet on 10 November. Need a flow wrap machine for rusk and cookie packs.
Hello Fatima ma'am! PR-FW250 horizontal flow wrap, 40-60 packs/min, ₹4,20,000 + GST. Lead time is about 10 days.
Can we see it running? Can I visit your factory on Monday?
Need liquid filling + capping for 1L HDPE bottles, about 1500 a day. Product is a bit thick, like shampoo.
Hello Manoj ji, our PR-PF1000 piston filler handles viscous liquids. With capping it is ₹3,80,000 + GST.
Can you do a trial with our sample before we order?
Sure ji, I will confirm a trial slot and send you our factory address by tomorrow.
Need pouch packing for 50g bhujia.
Hello Neha ji, PR-VF200 automatic VFFS, ₹3,90,000 + GST.
Too expensive for us. Small unit hai. Koi chhota option?
Yes ji, semi-auto PR-SA100 at ₹1,65,000 + GST, 15-20 pouches/min. Video: packright.in/v/sa100
Yeh theek lag raha hai. Video dekh ke batati hoon.
Hello Gopal sir, Priya from PackRight Machines. We supply automatic strapping machines for coir bales. Can I share details?
Send price.
PR-AS60 automatic strapping, ₹72,000 + GST.
Not now. Call after monsoon, in November.
